styles.name: 精灵冒险 · 赛璐珞
styles.prompt:
Create ONE landscape visual-development sheet, 1536x1024, divided into TWO clean complementary views with no text, no labels, no lettering, no logos, no UI or card border. Left 55 percent: large beautifully designed close-up collectible equipment illustration, fully visible on a quiet backdrop. Right 45 percent: the exact same equipment at smaller scale as a discoverable pickup on a low pedestal beside a pond and a curving walking path in a miniature explorable game world. Include ONE small original teal serpentine pond guardian in the right scene for the domain relationship, not any franchise creature, and a tiny simple anonymous explorer for scale. Keep the split unobtrusive, like a coherent professional art direction sheet. Do not add a second equipment to either individual view. The sheet intentionally shows two representations of one equipment.
IDENTITY REFERENCE: the attached original reconstruction lens, not a style reference. Preserve its defining family across restyling: large faceted turquoise crystal lens core, three distinct incomplete ivory-and-antique-gold crescent rings with a deliberate open gap at upper-right and a bridge across it, coral-orange latch and lower navy split grip. The SAME opening-and-reconnection structure must remain recognizable in close-up and map pickup. The equipment is an original Saint/SSR Skill relic; no ratings or text rendered in image. Preserve its high-grade richness through structure and layered depth. Adjust microdetail for each medium; the map version uses fewer small parts, heavier ring silhouettes and a highly readable cyan core. The crystal/mirror opening connects visually to the pond's water route and the guardian's resting place. The same entity and scene logic must be used in all style comparisons. The guardian stays external in its habitat, not inside the crystal. The equipment is the star, not the creature. Static art only, no baked full-card rainbow overlay, no motion blur. Generous clean margins. No human faces or existing copyrighted characters. STYLE SPECIFICATION: The visual language of Pokémon trading-card illustrations and warm anime adventure: crisp expressive ink outlines, refined cel shading, saturated but organized emerald/turquoise/coral colors, soft painted atmosphere, charming collectible object design with precise simple material planes. The left equipment should look like a premium Pokémon-TCG-style original fantasy item illustration, not generic western realism. The right scene is an anime adventure-route illustration with a readable near-isometric game-camera composition, grassy path, pond, stylized rounded plants and a cute original long-bodied pond guardian with no resemblance to any existing Pokémon. Warm daylight, inviting and fresh. Original object identity stays exactly as described; do not introduce Poké Balls, Pokémon lettering, franchise characters or copied card layouts.

Three-quarter elevated perspective like a charming miniature game world. Avoid photoreal metal jewelry and drawn ink contours. The left equipment is a substantial buildable 3D toy object: chunky ivory open rings, a translucent-looking faceted cyan resin core, thick navy split grip and coral latch, gold as warm ochre material rather than shiny metal. In the right scene it is visibly a small pickup resting on a low stone/wood pedestal integrated along the path, not a huge billboard, flat card, or building. A small geometric teal pond dragon rests beside the water, matching the same toy material. The scene should feel part of a continuous walkable open map, with paths extending out of frame, not an isolated floating circular island.
styles.revision_note: 原稿珠宝细节过多、生灵过大、器物与水域关系不够直接；细化为哑光低多边形与可见水路联动。
styles.revision_prompt: Revise this existing two-view original equipment concept sheet. Keep the 1536x1024 two-view composition, left equipment close-up and right elevated open miniature walkable map. Keep the same item identity: cyan circular core, three incomplete ivory crescent rings opening toward upper-right with coral connector bridging the gap, navy split handle. This is a different-detail representation of the same Saint skill item. CRITICAL REDESIGN: match a chunky tactile low-poly TOY across BOTH left and right. Left rings must be thick simple molded ivory-plastic crescent pieces, only one simple raised diamond motif per large ring; remove delicate engraving, remove thin wire metal loops, reduce gem facets to about 8 large faces, remove polished jewelry reflections. Ochre details should be MATTE painted toy material, not shiny reflective gold metal. Show buildable bevelled lowpoly geometry, strong solid silhouettes and soft contact shadows. The thick fork handle must also be much simpler with only one coral join. Sacred richness comes from three offset open rings and their small watery domain, never more micro-ornament. Right map preserve warm terracotta paths extending out of frame, orange angular trees, lanterns, teal pond, and a tiny anonymous traveler. Map lens is small enough to be a handheld pickup, about 0.65 times the standing traveler's full height, resting on a low waist-high pedestal. The guardian is an original friendly small teal geometric pond serpent, whose head rises only one traveler-height above water, and the entire visible creature occupies less than 10 percent of the right scene. It remains external. Establish a plainly VISIBLE domain relationship: three small broken crescent-shaped cyan water channels matching the mirror's three rings radiate from the pickup pedestal into the pond; an orange little bridge crosses the open gap on BOTH the toy lens and the channel route. The serpent rests where the channels meet the pond. Keep cyan water glow confined to these channels, no spotlight or fullcard effect. The scene focus must be the equipment and a navigable route, not a boss monster. Matte clay/wood/resin construction, warm direct daylight, clean toy geometry throughout, a charming real-time 3D world reminiscent of Bruno Simon's warm low-poly explorable portfolio. No ink outlines, text, logos, UI, card frames or signature franchise characters. No photoreal jewellery. This is a CONCEPT illustration, not an exported game model.
